text:
Maya (PM): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I pasted the action slate below. Need owners + due dates so we can close the RCA. Please claim items you own or reassign. Target: mark owners by EOD Thursday and have at least an initial plan by next week.

Actions:
1) Investigate + patch KV cache leak in serving runtime (regression tied to recent kernel change).  (approx severity: high)
2) Add automation to rollback canary when error-rate spikes > threshold. (canary/runbook update)
3) Dashboard: add failed-batch-rate metric and a per-model error trend. (observability)
4) Customer comms: draft notification for impacted accounts + internal escalation path. (comms)

Maya (PM): pinging teams — please reply with ownership + due date. @here

Sam P (Serving): I'll take #1. Plan: reproduce with smaller trace, add regression test, then patch. ETA: Mon COB. Branch: fix/kv-leak. Will open PR and link here.

Jordan S (SRE): I'll own #2. I'll wire up the canary rollback hook and add a runbook step. ETA: Wed EOD. Will coordinate with releases team for safe rollout.

Liam (Infra): I'll pick up #3 but need metrics schema from metrics team. ETA: next Tue if I get the schema by tomorrow.

Ava (Metrics): I can provide the schema. I'll drop a schema doc and Grafana panel config by tomorrow noon.

Sam P (Serving): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/pulls/482 — cc @Maya. Tests added to e2e-kv-suite. :thumbsup:

Jordan S (SRE): Canary job is release/canary-watch. I'll add a new step to trigger rollback when 5xx > 3% for 5m. I'll link runbook after tests.

Liam (Infra): Noted the panel config. If we need an aggregated metric we'll add a rollup job; otherwise Grafana alert will be fine. ETA confirmed: next Tue.

Ava (Metrics): Posted schema here: https://confluence.redwood/metrics/kv-failures — includes example query and sample alerts.

Maya (PM): Great — summary for closure:
- #1 Sam P — owner, due Mon COB (1745980000-ish) — Sam will post PR/merge plan.
- #2 Jordan S — owner, due Wed EOD — Jordan will add runbook and tests.
- #3 Liam — owner, due next Tue — depends on metrics schema from Ava (provided).
- #4 Maya — I'll draft customer comms and share for reviews by Friday noon; legal will sign off.

Maya (PM): Please paste PR/links when available so I can update the postmortem and mark items 'in progress'. If any blocker surfaces (e.g., need infra changes or release freeze) call it out here and I'll escalate.

Sam P (Serving): Noted, will tag @releases if we need a quick window. PR description includes roll-forward instructions.

Jordan S (SRE): If tests fail in canary I'll open an incident stub and flag releases. Plan to run e2e in staging first.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — closing the loop: I'll update RCA doc and re-open thread if dates slide. RCA-bot: please add owners to the RCA tracker.

RCA-bot: Owner metadata updated: Sam P -> item1, Jordan S -> item2, Liam -> item3, Maya -> item4. (automated)

Maya (PM): We're good for now. Will follow up during weekly ops sync. :tada:
